answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow: each agent locks 60 POA and records a fingerprint of timing, services and counterparties. Honest agents wander across services, so at dawn the fingerprint passes and escrow unlocks. Cloned sybils repeat one pattern, so fingerprints collide; the sable seal flags the cluster and locks their escrows for slashing. 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps every reward.
